summary_units.title: Lecture 2 - Manual Muscle Testing (MMT)
summary_units.summary: Functional Movement Science (HAS4867) Manual Muscle Testing (MMT) Manual muscle testing is a procedure for the evaluation of the strength of individual muscles and muscle groups based on the performance of a movement in relation to manual resistance. Patients are asked to hold a position against a therapist’s resistance. Resistance needs to be applied gradually in the opposite direction of muscle being tested. Both sides should be tested to provide a comparison. Muscle Strength Grading Scale (Oxford Scale) • Grade 0: No contraction • Grade1: Visible/palpable muscle contraction but no movement • Grade2: Completes ROM with gravity eliminated • Grade 3: Completes ROM against gravity only • Grade 4: Completes ROM against gravity with some resistance • Grade 5: Completes ROM against gravity with full resistance Testing position • Anti-Gravity – for muscle strength Grade 3 or above • Gravity Eliminated – for muscle strength Grade 2 or below
